# DSH Studio v0.7.8

This stability release fixes plugin installation, Windows terminal creation and concurrent desktop
state. It addresses [#11](https://github.com/Moresyl/dsh-studio/issues/11) and
[#12](https://github.com/Moresyl/dsh-studio/issues/12), refreshes expired install reviews, verifies the
complete dependency graph before touching a Profile, and surfaces package-manager causes in a copyable dialog.

## Added

- **Complete dependency preflight.** After metadata review, Studio uses the selected managed Node, pinned
  pnpm and the same registry to run `--lockfile-only --ignore-scripts` in a disposable project. It checks
  before confirmation, immediately before installation and during expired-token recovery without changing
  the real Profile's manifest, lockfile or plugin tree.
- **Unified failure dialog.** Plugin search, detail, source, install, remove and toggle failures keep their
  inline history and also open a localized dialog whose complete detail remains selectable and copyable.

## Changed and secured

- Dependency review and installation use the same registry. Preflight runs no lifecycle scripts, cleans its
  isolated project on every exit, and redacts authorization headers, tokens and URL credentials before output
  reaches the UI.
- Package-manager diagnostics retain a bounded 16-line tail and prioritize the actual `ERR_PNPM_*`, network,
  disk or permission cause over the Harness wrapper.
- Destructive Harness, terminal, plugin, preset and remote-session actions are mutually exclusive. Selection
  and generation guards prevent stale cross-window refreshes or rapid-click responses from overwriting a newer result.
- Windows log settings use atomic replacement; shortcut and notification writes are serialized, restoring the
  previous registered shortcut if persistence fails.

## Fixed and polished

- Fixed [#11](https://github.com/Moresyl/dsh-studio/issues/11): xterm's Unicode 11 addon accessed its proposed
  API before Studio enabled it, so New terminal could throw before PTY creation and appear inert on Windows 11.
- Fixed [#12](https://github.com/Moresyl/dsh-studio/issues/12): reviewed 1024Store snapshots may exceed the
  custom-source 2 MiB ceiling; dshfind uses bounded server-side desktop search; exact npm prerelease versions
  are accepted while ranges, tags and build metadata remain blocked.
- An expired one-shot install token is reviewed once again automatically. A changed package, version or source
  safely returns to detail instead of proceeding from stale intent.
- A missing or inaccessible transitive dependency now fails before the real Profile changes and reports causes
  such as `ERR_PNPM_FETCH_404`, the package name and registry response instead of only
  `dsh: pnpm failed in profile directory`.
- Fixed overlapping runtime operations, duplicate terminal/plugin/source/preset/remote actions, and late Profile,
  session, startup-settings or market refreshes restoring stale state.

## Install and update

All plugin-market users and Windows 11 embedded-terminal users should upgrade. Existing `~/.dsh` Profiles,
plugins, workspaces, sessions and credentials remain in place. If an upstream dependency is genuinely unpublished
or inaccessible, Studio stops before changing the Profile and provides a copyable cause; it never reports a false success.

Verify downloads with `SHA256SUMS.txt`; in-app updates continue to require the Tauri updater signature. Windows
Authenticode and Apple Developer ID are separate OS publisher signatures and depend on repository credentials.
